channel.title: Farsçadan (English)
channel.description: AI-assisted English translations of selected stories from Iran's Persian-language press. Every story notes the outlet's political orientation.

item.title: Pakistan military confirms deployment in Saudi Arabia: Three-way defense tie with Turkey
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Pakistani military spokesman confirmed troops in Saudi Arabia to CNN, pointing to trilateral defense bond with Turkey in Mecca Defense Pact. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: Houthis: Saudi Bayraktar Akinci UAV downed in Taiz airspace
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Yemen's Houthi military spokesman announced the downing of a Turkish-made Bayraktar Akinci UAV belonging to Saudi Arabia over Taiz. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Atlantic: White House wants Iran strike options ready before November 3 election
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Atlantic magazine reports White House requested Pentagon prepare Iran strike options implementable before November 3 midterm election. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Iran lays out terms to end war; agrees with Oman on Hormuz safe passage corridor
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Foreign ministry spokesman Bakaei announced Iran's conditions for ending war and said agreement reached with Oman on safe passage corridor in Hormuz. (Source: Donya-ye Eghtesad)

item.title: Parsian Bank moved millions in dollars with affiliate despite U.S. sanctions
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Investigation based on leaked documents shows Parsian Bank transferred millions abroad via Parsian Exchange despite U.S. sanctions. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Explosions in Riyadh, fire at Aramco facility; Yemen reports missile strike on Aden
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Riyadh experienced successive explosion sounds, a fire broke out at Aramco's Rabigh facility; Yemen reported missile strike on Aden Airport. (Source: ISNA)

item.title: Turkey deploys additional troops and air defense systems to Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Middle East Eye, Turkey will send additional military personnel, technicians, and air defense systems to protect Saudi Arabia's oil pipeline. (Source: Ettelaat (via Tasnim))

item.title: Vance: Iran must reduce uranium enrichment capacity for war to end
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: U.S. Vice President Vance told Reuters that for the war to end, Iran must reduce its uranium enrichment capacity. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: London espionage case: 3 Iranians accused of surveilling Iran International journalists
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: British prosecutors charge 3 Iranians under the National Security Act with surveilling and planning violence against Iran International journalists. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Iran International: At least 70 political prisoners executed since Dey month protests
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Iran International data from human rights groups, at least 70 political prisoners were executed since January 2026 protests; 194 await execution. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Houthis announced strike on Riyadh and Jeddah; Saudi coalition calls claim 'misleading'
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Houthis announced missile and drone strikes on Riyadh and Jeddah; flights were suspended, Saudi coalition denied the claim. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Fadavi: US Navy withdrew from Hormuz; that same evening, 'unauthorized' tanker was fired upon
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: General Fadavi announced the complete withdrawal of the US Navy from the region; that evening a tanker was reportedly fired upon in Hormuz. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: US withdraws all B-1 bombers from UK base amid terror plot investigation
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: The US withdrew all B-1 bomber aircraft from the Fairford base in the UK, where a terror plot investigation is underway. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: Oil Minister Paknejad resigns; Pezeshkian appoints Hamid Bord as acting minister
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned "for personal reasons"; President Pezeshkian appointed Hamid Bord as acting oil minister. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Kalaibaf says he was 'shocked' by $10,000 currency distribution to all adults; subsidies committee formed
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Parliament Speaker Kalaibaf said he was shocked by the Central Bank's $10,000 currency subsidy decision; government forms pricing committee. (Source: Kayhan)

item.title: Pezeshkian: Government has reorganized to counter "the enemy's economic war"
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: President Pezeshkian said the government has reorganized the economy for "war conditions," shifting priority to livelihoods and stability. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Houthis strike Aramco, Saudi Arabia bombs Sanaa; fighting escalates in Taiz
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: The Houthis hit Saudi Aramco facilities in Riyadh with missiles, Saudi jets bombed Sanaa, and fighting continues in Taiz. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Closing Hormuz: What does it gain Iran? Conflicting calculations in Tehran press
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Tehran newspapers debate whether closing Hormuz Strait helps or harms Iran long-term; oil rose to $103. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: US expels two Iranian UN diplomats for defying order to leave
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Axios, the US expelled two Iranian UN diplomats who ignored an order to leave New York as tensions escalate. (Source: Donya-ye Eghtesad)

item.title: Dollar tops 270,000 tomans as prosecutors threaten currency dealers with arrest
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: In Tehran the dollar passed 269,000 and the euro 302,000 tomans for the first time; prosecutors threatened dealers, and the central bank said "temporary." (Source: Iran International)
